description:
An open-source, local-first AI desktop app that directs specialist sub-agents and runs your installed coding CLIs.

Orkas is an open-source, local-first AI desktop app. A commander LLM directs specialist sub-agents and runs your installed coding CLIs, such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw and Hermes, as local sessions. Agents self-evolve via reflection and skill crystallization, and you bring your own keys.

Highlights
- Create and refine videos with clearer timeline controls, more predictable audio mixing, and better delivery of exported files.
- Work with local speech and audio using improved voice generation, recorded clips, and audio enhancement.
- Resume interrupted work with clearer conversation history, project context, and task recovery.
Improvements
- Move between projects, task shortcuts, and conversations with more consistent task status and desktop notifications.
- Upload folders in the built-in browser and access downloaded files from the conversation.
Fixes
- Preserve document contents and previews when reviewing or correcting Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files.
- Preserve session history and recover file delivery when external CLI agents encounter interruptions.
